**Model table generation (origin and destination).** One function builds the table for a period, so the
development and test tables are made by identical code.

```{r build-function}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
source("scripts/weather_decoder.R")

D <- "data/processed/closed10"

# ==========================================
# 1. Weather (shared by both periods)
# ==========================================
weather <- read_csv(file.path(D, "weather_10airports_2025JanSep.csv.gz"),
                    col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
  mutate(valid = ymd_hm(valid, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(valid)) %>%
  arrange(iata, valid) %>%
  group_by(iata, valid) %>%                 # duplicate timestamps: keep the last archive row
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sknt = as.numeric(na_if(sknt, "M")),
    vsby = as.numeric(na_if(vsby, "M")),
    gust_indicator = ifelse(is.na(gust) | gust == "M", 0, 1),   # M = no gust reported
    gust = as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(gust) | gust == "M", "0", gust)),
    p01i = as.numeric(ifelse(!is.na(p01i) & p01i == "T", "0.0001", na_if(p01i, "M"))),  # trace -> 0.0001
    ts_flag = ifelse(str_detect(wxcodes, "TS"), 1, 0)            # includes VCTS (thunderstorm in vicinity)
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(decode_present_weather(.$metar))  # precip_intensity (0-3), snow_fzra_flag

weather_cols <- c("sknt", "gust", "gust_indicator", "vsby", "p01i", "ts_flag", "snow_fzra_flag", "precip_intensity")
weather_small <- weather %>% select(iata, valid, all_of(weather_cols))

# US federal holidays around the study window (Dec 2024 - Oct 2025)
us_holidays <- as.Date(c("2024-12-25", "2025-01-01", "2025-01-20", "2025-02-17", "2025-05-26",
                         "2025-06-19", "2025-07-04", "2025-09-01", "2025-10-13"))

# Attach the latest report at `airport` with valid <= `target`; keep it only if `keep(valid)` holds.
attach_weather <- function(flights, airport, target, suffix, keep) {
  flights %>%
    mutate(.airport = .data[[airport]], .target = .data[[target]]) %>%
    left_join(weather_small, by = join_by(.airport == iata, closest(.target >= valid))) %>%
    select(-.airport, -.target) %>%
    mutate(keep_row = keep(valid, cutoff_utc, scheduled_dep, scheduled_arr) %in% TRUE) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(weather_cols), ~ ifelse(keep_row, .x, NA)),
           valid = if_else(keep_row, valid, as.POSIXct(NA, tz = "UTC"))) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, suffix), all_of(c(weather_cols, "valid"))) %>%
    select(-keep_row)
}
within_120 <- function(v, c, dep, arr) as.numeric(difftime(c, v, units = "mins")) <= 120  # C: v <= c, age <= 120
after_cut_dep <- function(v, c, dep, arr) v > c & v <= dep                                # W: (c, sched dep]
after_cut_arr <- function(v, c, dep, arr) v > c & v <= arr                                # W: (c, sched arr]

build_model_table <- function(period, flight_file) {
  history <- read_csv(file.path(D, paste0("features_history_", period, ".csv.gz")), show_col_types = FALSE)
  flights <- read_csv(file.path(D, flight_file), show_col_types = FALSE,
                      col_types = cols(CRSDepTime = col_character(), CRSArrTime = col_character(),
                                       DepTime = col_character(), ArrTime = col_character(),
                                       WheelsOff = col_character(), WheelsOn = col_character())) %>%
    left_join(history, by = "flight_id") %>%
    mutate(
      cutoff_utc = force_tz(cutoff_utc, tzone = "UTC"),
      scheduled_dep = cutoff_utc + minutes(120),
      scheduled_arr = scheduled_dep + minutes(CRSElapsedTime),
      dep_hour = as.numeric(CRSDepTime) %/% 100,          # local hour at origin
      arr_hour = as.numeric(CRSArrTime) %/% 100,          # local hour at destination
      days_to_holiday = map_dbl(as.Date(FlightDate),      # FlightDate = local departure date
                                ~ min(abs(as.numeric(.x - us_holidays))))
    )

  flights <- flights %>%
    attach_weather("Origin", "cutoff_utc",    "_C",          within_120) %>%
    attach_weather("Origin", "scheduled_dep", "_W",          after_cut_dep) %>%
    attach_weather("Dest",   "cutoff_utc",    "_Dest_C",     within_120) %>%
    attach_weather("Dest",   "scheduled_dep", "_Dest_W_dep", after_cut_dep) %>%
    attach_weather("Dest",   "scheduled_arr", "_Dest_W_arr", after_cut_arr)

  stopifnot(nrow(flights) == n_distinct(flights$flight_id))           # no duplicated flights
  stopifnot(all(flights$valid_C <= flights$cutoff_utc, na.rm = TRUE),   # clean weather never after cutoff
            all(flights$valid_Dest_C <= flights$cutoff_utc, na.rm = TRUE))

  flights %>%
    select(flight_id, Origin, Dest, cutoff_utc, scheduled_dep, scheduled_arr,
           days_to_holiday, dep_hour, arr_hour,
           ends_with("_C"), ends_with("_W"), ends_with("_W_dep"), ends_with("_W_arr"),
           DepDelay, TaxiOut, everything())
}

check_table <- function(tab, label) {
  cat("--- Random 3 flights:", label, "---\n")
  tab %>%
    select(flight_id, Dest, cutoff_utc, valid_Dest_C, scheduled_dep, valid_Dest_W_dep, scheduled_arr, valid_Dest_W_arr) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 3) %>% print()
  cat("--- Origin clean-weather missing rate:", label, "---\n")
  tab %>% group_by(Origin) %>%
    summarise(total_flights = n(), missing_weather_count = sum(is.na(sknt_C)),
              missing_rate_pct = round(mean(is.na(sknt_C)) * 100, 2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(missing_rate_pct)) %>% print()
  cat("--- Precipitation intensity (0 none, 1 light, 2 moderate, 3 heavy), origin C ---\n")
  print(table(tab$precip_intensity_C, useNA = "ifany"))
}
```

**Development data (January–June 2025)**

```{r dev}
model_table_dev <- build_model_table("dev", "flights_closed10_dev_2025JanJun.csv.gz")
check_table(model_table_dev, "dev")
write_csv(model_table_dev, file.path(D, "model_table_dev.csv.gz"))
```

**Test data (July–September 2025).** Built with the same code; not to be inspected or used before final evaluation.

```{r test}
model_table_test <- build_model_table("test", "flights_closed10_test_2025JulSep.csv.gz")
write_csv(model_table_test, file.path(D, "model_table_test.csv.gz"))
```
